review_evidence: README identifies a Lean/mathlib formalization of Leray-Hopf weak existence for incompressible Navier-Stokes on the 3-torus and R^3, including finite- and global-in-time capstone theorems.

The unit contains analysis, Galerkin, Bochner, torus, and R3 proof modules plus scratch/fixture files; representative scratch fixtures deliberately declare structures and theorems used to verify declaration-surface invariants.

Scratch, experimental, and script paths cannot be excluded by name under FILTER-010/FILTER-011, and inspected examples contain actual declarations/proofs, so no content-lossless primary exclusion was established.
summary: Retain the complete Leray-Hopf formal development, including scratch and fixture modules that contain explicit formal declarations and proof checks.
